notes.title: 5-Hour Timed Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that a 5-hour timed demo of Digital Humans is now available on Steam! This is your chance to dive into the full Early Access version and experience AI-driven conversations like never before.

[list]
[*] Talk to AI characters that listen, react, and respond dynamically
[*] Seamless voice input & output for natural conversations
[*] Full Early Access experience – no feature restrictions
[*] 5 hours of playtime – explore at your own pace
[*] Runs entirely offline – no cloud processing required
[/list]

This is just the beginning—your feedback helps shape the future!

notes.title: Update Notes 24 Feb
notes.content:
[h3]New capture options:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Device selection
[*] Activation Modes:
[b]Push-To-Talk[/b] Activates the microphone only when a designated key or button is pressed, ensuring that only intentional speech is transmitted while minimizing background noise and unintended audio capture.
[b]Responsive Toggle[/b] Automatically mutes the microphone while the bot is speaking, then unmutes once the response is complete, preventing audio feedback and ensuring clear communication.
[b]Voice Sense[/b] Voice activation for settings where game audio isn’t captured by the microphone.
[*] [b]Recognition Delay[/b] The interval between when speech is recognized and when the corresponding text is sent to the chat. Lower delay values are ideal for fast speakers, while higher values are recommended for users who naturally pause during their speech.
[*] [b]Configurable PPT/Interrupt Hotkey[/b] A customizable key or button that activates push-to-talk and instantly interrupts bot responses, ensuring user commands always take precedence.
